bld_extractor.name: Extractor
bld_extractor.description: Built on a resource node. Produces whatever the node yields.

bld_splitter.name: Splitter
bld_splitter.description: Sends one incoming flow out several sides.

bld_merger.name: Merger
bld_merger.description: Joins several flows of the same kind into one.

bld_crossover.name: Crossover
bld_crossover.description: Lets two flows pass each other at right angles.

bld_tunnel_in.name: Tunnel entrance
bld_tunnel_in.description: Bought with its exit. Takes a flow in at its back and carries it in a straight line under whatever lies between, to the exit it faces.

bld_tunnel_out.name: Tunnel exit
bld_tunnel_out.description: Bought with its entrance. Lets the flow of the entrance that faces it out at its back.

bld_range.name: Range
bld_range.description: Consumes {res_a} to train archers, ranged units that shoot enemies from a distance, flying ones included.

bld_hangar.name: Hangar
bld_hangar.description: Consumes {res_b} to build drones, flying units that cross walls and lakes and shoot ground and air targets.

bld_foundry.name: Foundry
bld_foundry.description: Consumes {res_a} and {res_b} together to cast heavy units. Needs both at once; without one it waits.

bld_grand_barracks.name: Grand barracks
bld_grand_barracks.description: Consumes {res_a} to train two soldiers at a time, for less {res_a} each than a Barracks. Needs the {res_a} of two collectors of its tier; with one it runs at half speed.

bld_mana_well.name: Mana Well
bld_mana_well.description: The Flowmancer's own collector. It stands on any open cell of your area, no node needed, and makes the resource you set it to ({res_a}, {res_b} or {res_c}), at half the speed of an Extractor.

bld_rune_ward.name: Rune Ward
bld_rune_ward.description: The Wardsmith's own ward. Fed with {res_b}, it strikes back at an enemy unit that hits a wall or gate of yours beside it.

bld_familiar_roost.name: Familiar Roost
bld_familiar_roost.description: The Beastbinder's own producer: consumes {res_b} to raise Familiars, fast and fragile fighters.

bld_transmuter.name: Transmuter
bld_transmuter.description: The Alchemist's own refinery: turns one base resource into another at a loss.

bld_lancer_hall.name: Lancer hall
bld_lancer_hall.description: Consumes {res_a} to train lancers. Long and thin, so it fits along walls and plot edges.

bld_refinery_ab.name: Composite Refinery
bld_refinery_ab.description: Combines {res_a} and {res_b} into Composite and sends it down its output conduit. Needs both at once; without one it waits.

bld_refinery_bc.name: Aether Refinery
bld_refinery_bc.description: Combines {res_b} and {res_c} into Aether and sends it down its output conduit. Needs both at once; without one it waits.

bld_golem_forge.name: Golem forge
bld_golem_forge.description: Consumes {res_ab_refined} to raise golems: huge, slow, armored units that shrug off weak hits.

bld_spire.name: Spire
bld_spire.description: Consumes {res_bc_refined} to raise casters: fragile ranged units whose hits also splash the enemies standing around the target.

bld_wall_i.name: Wall (I)
bld_wall_i.description: Blocks enemy movement. Covers four cells in a I shape; rotate it to fit.

bld_wall_o.name: Wall (O)
bld_wall_o.description: Blocks enemy movement. Covers four cells in a O shape; rotate it to fit.

bld_wall_t.name: Wall (T)
bld_wall_t.description: Blocks enemy movement. Covers four cells in a T shape; rotate it to fit.

bld_wall_s.name: Wall (S)
bld_wall_s.description: Blocks enemy movement. Covers four cells in a S shape; rotate it to fit.

bld_wall_z.name: Wall (Z)
bld_wall_z.description: Blocks enemy movement. Covers four cells in a Z shape; rotate it to fit.

bld_wall_l.name: Wall (L)
bld_wall_l.description: Blocks enemy movement. Covers four cells in a L shape; rotate it to fit.

bld_wall_j.name: Wall (J)
bld_wall_j.description: Blocks enemy movement. Covers four cells in a J shape; rotate it to fit.

bld_wall_block.name: Wall (single)
bld_wall_block.description: A one-cell wall that enemy strongholds and the reference boards use. It is not sold in the shop.

bld_gate.name: Gate
bld_gate.description: Blocks enemies but lets your own units through.

bld_turret.name: Turret
bld_turret.description: Uses {res_b} to shoot enemies that reach your board.

bld_mortar.name: Mortar
bld_mortar.description: Uses {res_a} to lob shells at enemies far away. Each shell also hurts the enemies around its target, but the Mortar cannot hit anything close to it.

bld_overclocker.name: Overclocker
bld_overclocker.description: Consumes {res_c} to make sources faster for the rest of the battle.

bld_armory.name: Armory
bld_armory.description: Consumes {res_a} to make units spawned later in the battle stronger.

bld_pylon.name: Pylon
bld_pylon.description: Only a boss has these. While one stands, the boss Core it guards takes no damage.

bld_core.name: Core
bld_core.description: Your party's health. If it falls, the battle is lost.

unit_soldier.name: Soldier
unit_soldier.description: Marches on the enemy Core and attacks whatever blocks the way.

unit_raider.name: Raider
unit_raider.description: Small, fast and fragile: marches on the enemy Core like a soldier.

unit_heavy.name: Heavy
unit_heavy.description: A slow-built bruiser: far tougher and harder-hitting than a soldier. Marches on the enemy Core and attacks whatever blocks the way.

unit_golem.name: Golem
unit_golem.description: Huge and slow, with armor 3: every hit on it deals 3 less (at least 1). Marches on the enemy Core and attacks whatever blocks the way.

unit_caster.name: Caster
unit_caster.description: Fragile, shoots from a distance, flying enemies too. Its hit on a unit also deals half as much to every other enemy unit within one cell of the target.

unit_lancer.name: Lancer
unit_lancer.description: Fragile, but its spear reaches over the ally in front, so it fights from the second rank. Hits ground enemies only.

unit_archer.name: Archer
unit_archer.description: Shoots enemies from a distance, flying ones too. Stops to fire when something is in range.

unit_drone.name: Drone
unit_drone.description: Flies straight at the enemy Core over walls and lakes. Only ranged units and turrets can hit it.

ter_lake.name: Lake
ter_lake.description: Impassable water. Nothing can be built on it.

ter_cliff.name: Cliff
ter_cliff.description: An impassable ridge. Nothing can be built on it.

arch_rusher.name: Rusher
arch_rusher.description: Heavy waves from the first seconds against a stronghold with almost no defenses.

arch_fortress.name: Fortress
arch_fortress.description: A heavily defended stronghold ringed with walls and turrets. Light waves that arrive late.

arch_escalator.name: Escalator
arch_escalator.description: Waves that grow quickly, behind a line of walls and turrets.

arch_skirmishers.name: Skirmishers
arch_skirmishers.description: Archers behind a soldier screen, against an open stronghold ringed with turrets.
arch_skirmishers.tests: fast melee to catch archers, and turrets; walls do nothing against arrows

arch_swarm.name: Swarm
arch_swarm.description: Small raider waves, one after another, against an open stronghold with a small Core.

arch_maze.name: Maze
arch_maze.description: Light waves, against a winding walled path to the Core lined with turrets.
arch_maze.tests: a strong army that pushes through, or breaching the walls

arch_focus.name: Focus
arch_focus.description: Normal waves, but each one enters through a single plot, against a ring stronghold. Each wave hits one of you.
arch_focus.tests: covering each other across the borders

arch_juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
arch_juggernaut.description: A few slow, very tough waves of heavies and Golems, against a stronghold behind a wall line.
arch_juggernaut.tests: focused damage, and walls to buy time

arch_coven.name: Coven
arch_coven.description: Casters behind a soldier screen, against a ring stronghold.
arch_coven.tests: spread-out units; armored Golems shrug off splash

arch_boss.name: Boss
arch_boss.description: A strong stronghold with steady waves and a signature unit every few waves.

arch_boss_brood.name: Brood
arch_boss_brood.description: The boss's Cores release a burst of units each time they fall below three quarters, half and a quarter of their health.

arch_boss_linked.name: Bonded
arch_boss_linked.description: The boss's Cores share one health pool: every Core you hit hurts them all, and they fall together.

arch_boss_pylons.name: Pylons
arch_boss_pylons.description: The boss's Cores take no damage while the pylons around them stand: destroy the pylons first.

arch_boss_warlord.name: Warlord
arch_boss_warlord.description: Every wave is led by a champion Golem with several times a Golem's health. Bring enough damage to bring it down.

spec_flowmancer.name: Flowmancer
spec_flowmancer.description: A weak collector for any open cell, no node. You pick the resource.

spec_wardsmith.name: Wardsmith
spec_wardsmith.bonus: Walls, gates and turrets get about 15% more health.
spec_wardsmith.description: Enemies that hit a wall beside it take damage back.

spec_beastbinder.name: Beastbinder
spec_beastbinder.bonus: Units from your producers get about 10% more health.
spec_beastbinder.description: Makes Familiars: fast, fragile melee units.

spec_alchemist.name: Alchemist
spec_alchemist.bonus: Refineries and ramp buildings work about 15% faster.
spec_alchemist.description: Turns one base resource into another at a loss. You pick the output.

screens.bossMechanicPlain: Every third wave is a swarm of raiders.
screens.bossMechanicBurst: Its Cores burst out a swarm of units each time their health falls to 75%, 50% and 25%.
screens.bossMechanicPool: Its Cores share one health pool: a hit on any Core hurts them all, and they fall together.
screens.bossMechanicShield: Its Cores take no damage while the pylons beside them stand.
screens.bossMechanicChampion: Every wave is led by a champion Golem with several times a Golem's health.
screens.bossMechanicUnknown: A computer-made stronghold, not another party.
screens.bossCounterBurst: Keep defense at home; don't go all-in on attack.
screens.bossCounterPool: A strong lane carries a weak one: total pressure matters.
screens.bossCounterShield: Bring enough units to break through, and ranged units to reach the pylons.
screens.bossCounterChampion: Focused damage and walls that delay it; its armor shrugs off splash.
screens.bossCounterUnknown: Defense at home, and enough attack to break through.

screens.uiRunConflictTitle: This run changed in another tab

screens.uiRunRemoveNote: Removing the save deletes it for good, with no summary and no record.
screens.uiRunRemoveWarning: Remove this save? It is deleted for good, with no summary and no record of the run.

screens.uiRunUnopenableTitle: The saved run cannot be opened

screens.uiCheckNothingYet: Nothing to check yet. Drag a building from the inventory onto the board.
screens.uiCheckAllPlaced: Everything in the inventory is placed

screens.battleSummaryDoubleFallLoss: Draw: both {core}s fell at {time}. They win the tiebreak.

screens.battleTipNoBuildings: Place buildings from the tray before pressing Ready.
screens.battleTipExtractor: You have no {source} to spare. Pick one up from the board and move it onto a {resource} node, or buy one in the shop. Then draw a conduit to the {building}.
screens.battleTipConduit: Draw a conduit from a {resource} {source} to the {building}. The Build checklist turns green when it's connected.
screens.battleTipBreach: Turn on {paths} and block that side with walls.
screens.battleTipGeneric: Add turrets or more unit buildings before pressing Ready.
screens.choiceSubtitle: A computer-run stronghold. Harder ones pay more gold.
screens.choiceStakes: Losing this battle costs no life. You just don't get the gold.
screens.choiceOverloadShared: At {at} both Cores start losing health (Overload).
screens.eventTrayPick: Pick one. It applies right away.
screens.eventTrayShrine: Shrine bonuses last the whole run.
screens.eventNextRival: Next: shop and build for the rival party.
screens.eventNextBuild: Next: build for the next round's Stronghold.
screens.battleLastLife: That was your last life. The run is over.
screens.uiMapFitTip: Fit the board to the screen
screens.uiMapTestRunOnlyBuild: The test run is only available while you build
screens.uiKitRandomWallTip: Walls come in random shapes. You see them in the inventory after you place the Core.
screens.specialistSubtitle: Choose one. Duplicates are allowed. There is no skip.
screens.specialistNote: Ready locks your pick. Nothing is given to a partner.
screens.coreAbout: The Core is the heart of your base. If enemies destroy it, you lose the battle.
screens.coreClickPost: . You can change the spot until you press Place Core. After that it's fixed.
screens.coreNextPost: and place the buildings shown below the board. Nothing fights until you press Ready.
screens.uiPhaseDescSetup: Happens once per run, before round 1.
screens.uiPhaseDescBuild: Place buildings, then press Ready. Nothing fights until you do, so take your time.
screens.uiPhaseDescFight: Your base fights on its own. You can't change it now, only watch.
screens.uiPhaseDescReward: Pick one event (gold, an upgrade or a bonus). Then shop and build for the next battle.
screens.tutSkipAsk: Hide all tips for this run?
screens.tutHoverNote: Point at anything on the board to see what it is.
screens.tutStep1Body: Choose where your Core goes, then press **Place Core**.
screens.tutStep2Body: Drag **one Extractor** from the tray below the board onto a glowing **Ore node**. Keep the other one for later.
screens.tutStep3Head: Feed a Barracks with a conduit
screens.tutStep3Place: Drag a **Barracks** from the tray onto the board, close to your Extractor.
screens.tutStep3Link: Pick the **Conduit** tool, then drag from the Extractor to the Barracks. The dashed line is one way to run it.
screens.tutStep4Head: Guard the Core with a Turret
screens.tutStep4Body: Drag a **Turret** from the tray next to your Core. **Enemy paths** are on: the red dashes are where enemies walk.
screens.tutStep4Power: A Turret shoots Power. Drag your second **Extractor** onto a ringed **Power node**.
screens.tutStep4Link: Pick the **Conduit** tool, then drag from the Power Extractor to the Turret. The dashed line is one way to run it.
screens.tutStep4NoSpare: A Turret shoots Power, and you have no Extractor left. Pick one up from the board and move it onto a ringed **Power node**.
screens.tutStep5Ready: Your base is ready. Press **Ready** to leave Build.
screens.tutStep5Warnings: **Before you fight** still lists warnings. Fix what you can, then press **Ready**.
screens.tutStep5Choose: Each round has two battles. First a stronghold you choose, then a rival party. Try **Easy**, then press **Fight**.
screens.tutStep6Body: Nothing to do here. Your Soldiers march to their Core and your Turret guards yours. Use the **speed controls** to go faster, or skip.
screens.tutClosingBody: That's your first battle. Next: pick a reward, then shop for the rival party battle. Losing to a rival party costs a life.
screens.tutClosingLost: You lost this one, and that is fine. Read the cause and what to try on the result card, then rebuild.
screens.tutClosingLostStep2: You lost this one. Step 2 was not done: put an Extractor on an Ore node, or nothing can be built.
screens.tutClosingLostStep3: You lost this one. Step 3 was not done: a Barracks only makes Soldiers when a conduit brings it Ore.
screens.tutClosingLostStep4: You lost this one. Step 4 was not done: a Turret near your Core only fires when a conduit brings it Power.

screens.menuPitch: Build a factory. It trains an army. The army fights for you. Survive as many rounds as you can.
screens.menuPlayTutorialHint: Your first real run, with tips · about 5 minutes
screens.menuStepBuildBody: Place buildings around your Core. Extractors mine resources, conduits carry them, and other buildings turn them into units and turret fire.
screens.menuStepFightBody: The battle plays itself. You watch. The first side to destroy the other’s Core wins.
screens.menuStepRewardBody: Earn gold, pick one event, and buy new buildings. Then build again.
screens.menuLivesRule: You start with {lives} lives. Losing to a rival party costs one. The run ends at 0.
